Attendees: L. Lee (Chair), N. Ahmed (CFO), D. Swan, S. Bao, F. Ritter, E. Dennis (Corp. Sec.), H. Pell (outside counsel, Item 3 only)
Status: DRAFT, minutes pending

Item 3: Q3 Financial Review (CFO)
- Q3 net loss approx. $14M vs. $3.1M budget (preliminary, pre-close). Portfolio occupancy ~71%.
- Covenant status: Fixed charge coverage appears to be below the 1.20x minimum on the Q3 test (CFO cited ~0.96x, subject to lender's calculation). Leverage appears above the 4.75x maximum (~5.4x, definitions under review).
- Waiver requested from Meridian Credit Partners; no response as of 10/19.
- Meridian facility (~$212M) may cross-default to Harbor & Pike mezzanine, pending counsel's reading of the documents. CFO noted a payment/covenant default is possible within 60 days if no waiver is obtained; some discussion of whether lender forbearance is likely.
- Liquidity runway roughly 5 months at current burn per CFO's estimate; Ritter questioned burn assumptions.

Item 4: Restructuring
- Board agreed to explore restructuring options. Advisor engagement (Kestrel Advisory) to be finalized by 11/30. Four underperforming sites under review.
- F. Ritter requested a default scenario analysis for next meeting.
